title: More checkerboards and mazes
items: Added honeycomb and triangle checkerboards, with true hexagons and triangles in the board, repeat tile and PDF
Added triangle and diamond mazes, with every algorithm, the poster PDF and PNG

title: Checkerboard maker
items: Added a checkerboard maker with your own rows, columns, box ratios and colors

title: Blog images
items: Added a featured image for each post on the blog page

title: Crochet colorwork squares
items: Added crochet colorwork at /crochet/colorwork/: tapestry charts, corner-to-corner graphs and granny squares, each written out as a complete multi-color square with a printable PDF

title: Knit colorwork patterns
items: Added knit colorwork: thirteen original stranded, mosaic and intarsia charts, written as complete squares with a float check, yarn per color and a PDF

title: Fractal maker
items: Added a fractal maker, with nine types, SVG and PNG downloads and a printable PDF

title: Poster-size mazes
items: Mazes with your own columns and rows, Master and Extreme levels, poster PDFs and very large PNGs

title: Maze generator
items: Added a maze generator with square, rectangular, circular and hexagonal mazes, five algorithms, a PDF with a separate solution page, and SVG and PNG of the maze and its solution

title: Tie-dye planner
items: Added a tie-dye planner, with a preview, dye map, mixing amounts and a printable PDF

title: Complete cross-stitch and needlepoint projects
items: Split needlepoint into its own maker, with canvas mesh, stitch and yarn choices, and a blocking and finishing margin
Both makers now give materials, stitching order, skein estimates, and framing or pillow steps
Added six complete square designs to each maker, and PDF charts that split over sheets with overlap

title: Complete crochet squares
items: Crochet stitch pages and PDFs now write a complete square: materials, foundation chain, every row with stitch counts, an edging with corners, and finishing
Added 6, 8, 10 and 12 inch square sizes to the crochet builder

title: Complete knitted squares
items: Knitting stitch pages now write a complete square pattern, in 6, 8, 10 or 12 inch sizes, on the page and in the PDF

title: Mandala rings, palettes and pattern pages
items: Ring-by-ring mandala builder with drag and drop and nine new motifs
Palette library by theme and color harmony, with your own palettes saved in the browser
Pages and thumbnails for the main options of eight makers
Front page and library with more patterns of each type, in alphabetical order
Language now changes only one secondary color
Seeds are remembered in your browser instead of in links

items: Added a Truchet tile maker, with seamless SVG and PNG repeats and a printable PDF

title: Mandala maker
items: Added a mandala maker for geometric radial designs, with colored SVG and PNG, coloring pages and printable PDFs

title: Stained glass pattern maker
items: Added a stained glass pattern maker, with numbered true-size templates, strict cutting rules and a rough glass estimate

title: Celtic knot maker
items: Added a Celtic knot maker, with cut files, tattoo stencils, coloring pages, PNG and printable PDF
